primary_checks: OCHA OPT checked first. No new qualifying Gaza development was found in the observation window; the newest surfaced OCHA Gaza situation report remained dated 18 September 2026.

WHO checked second. No new qualifying Gaza-specific development was found in the observation window; the WHO conflict page surfaced no Gaza-specific update newer than the 24 September 2026 UNGA remarks.
search_scope: civilian casualties and military operations with documented civilian impact
healthcare disruption, hospitals, ambulances, fuel, functioning capacity, and medical evacuation
exclusions: same-day material without a verifiable publication/event time inside the observation window
broad status commentary without a distinct new operational development
degradation: UN News direct retrieval was blocked by robots.txt; the same-day UN-associated syndicated item surfaced only broad ongoing humanitarian-access, water, sanitation, shelter, healthcare and reconstruction constraints and did not establish a distinct in-window change. Remaining humanitarian and established-source coverage was usable.
coverage_notes.result: No distinct development within the observation window met the novelty and traceability threshold.
